claude-opus-4-7.tokenizer_note: Opus 4.7 uses a new tokenizer (~555k words per 1M tokens)

claude-sonnet-4-6.delta_since_playbook: Context window upgraded from 200k -> 1M tokens; matches Opus 4.7

motoquant_current_routing.status: ALL CURRENT — on frontier as of 2026-05-24. No urgent migration required.

skills.description: Package repeatable workflows as shareable slash commands (/review-pr, /deploy-staging).
skills.rationale: Toolkit shortlist already calls for a motoquant.skill teaching bike-spec schema + glossary. Native Skills system makes this trivial vs ad-hoc.

routines.description: Anthropic-managed scheduled agent runs. Survives local power-off. Triggerable from web/Desktop/CLI /schedule. Also triggers on API calls or GitHub events.
routines.rationale: Could replace scripts/master_scheduler.sh local cron entirely. Current setup needs a host machine running 24/7 — Routines eliminate that. Evaluate against the resilience.sh power-cut handling.

channels.description: Push events from Telegram/Discord/iMessage/webhooks into a Claude Code session.
channels.rationale: DISPATCH_INBOX.md is currently a file-polling pattern. Telegram → Channels could give the user true async push from phone during the 8h internship without the user having to remember to write to inbox.

background_agents.description: Run several full sessions in parallel, watch them from one screen.
background_agents.rationale: Direct replacement for the parallel-Cowork-chat orchestration pattern documented in CLAUDE.md (April-24 7-stream session). Native primitive vs manual /tmp clone juggling.

sub_agents.description: Spawn multiple Claude Code agents working on different parts of a task. Lead agent coordinates, assigns subtasks, merges results.
sub_agents.rationale: Cleanup-rotation already uses 7 subagents via scripts/run_cleanup_subagents.sh. Native sub-agents primitive could simplify; evaluate at next cleanup-rotation Sunday.

agent_sdk.description: Build custom agents with full control over orchestration, tool access, permissions. Powered by Claude Code's tools.
agent_sdk.rationale: Could underpin the 12 production agents in scripts/agents/*. Not urgent — current prompt-template approach works. Re-evaluate when agent count crosses 25 or self-review starts proposing structural changes.

github_actions.description: Automate PR reviews and issue triage in CI.
github_actions.rationale: .github/workflows already has ci.yml + release.yml + web-verify.yml + keepalive.yml. Adding Claude PR review on every PR would catch the class of regression that the May-3 catalog drift introduced (5 stale 334-bike references). Quality-gate before adopting.

slack_integration.description: Mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report; get a pull request back.
slack_integration.rationale: User is solo + on Indian internship; no team Slack. Logged only.

code_review_native.description: Automatic Claude code review on every PR.
code_review_native.rationale: Free quality gate. Evaluate after the pytest-regressions baseline (toolkit shortlist #1) is in place so reviewer has firm baseline contract to enforce.

mcp_support.description: Connect external data sources: Google Drive, Jira, Slack, custom tooling.
mcp_support.rationale: Toolkit shortlist already includes building a MotoQuant MCP server. Evaluate Notion MCP for product-priorities sync, Railway MCP for /api/health probing without curl, GitHub MCP as gh-CLI alternative.

extended_thinking.motoquant_use_case: physics validation reasoning, calibrator search space exploration

priority_tier.motoquant_use_case: production /api/chat latency SLO when MotoQuant launches paid tier
